name: OKC_REVIEW_VAR_VALUES
description: This table is used to store variable values during upload from word document.

columns.name: VARIABLE_NAME
columns.description: Variable Name for the Clause referred to using review_upld_terms_id

columns.name: VARIABLE_LANGUAGE
columns.description: Language in which User uploaded the document

columns.name: VARIABLE_CODE
columns.description: This shows the Variable Code used in the document

columns.name: VARIABLE_TYPE
columns.description: This shows the type of the variable. The valid values are S=System, U=User Defined, T=Table, D=Deliverable.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_SET_ID
columns.description: This defines the Value Set of the user-defined variable value.

columns.name: VARIABLE_VALUE_ID
columns.description: Id of the Value chosen for that variable in the document. It applies only for LOVs,Choice Lists.

columns.name: VARIABLE_VALUE
columns.description: Variable Value chosen for that variable in the document. It applied to free format variable values.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CHANGED
columns.description: This flag is used to track if a variable value was changed during upload.

columns.name: OLD_REVIEW_UPLD_TERMS_ID
columns.description: It stores the original id of the review terms before Merge.

columns.name: ACTION
columns.description: It stores the action performed on the variable during terms upload. Possible values are "UPDATED", "DELETED","ADDED".

columns.name: EXTERNAL_YN
columns.description: This flag indicates if the variable value can be edited by external party like supplier etc.
